item.title: Hanamaki Onsen: Iwate's Rose-Garden Hot Spring Resort — Guide
item.description: Hanamaki Onsen is a classic hot-spring resort town in central Iwate — grand ryokan, a celebrated rose garden and quiet mountain baths gathered near the home of beloved poet Miyazawa Kenji. It’s an easy, comfortable onsen base for exploring the surrounding highlands and Hiraizumi to the south. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Hanamaki, Iwate Hours Day bathing hours vary; stays overnight Admission Day bath ~¥800; stays vary Time needed Half day (or overnight) Best time Year-round; roses late May–Jun What to See Grand ryokan and mountain hot-spring baths.

item.title: Nakanoshima Guide: Osaka's Riverside Island of Art & Architecture
item.description: A long, slender island between two rivers in the heart of Osaka, Nakanoshima is the city’s most refined district — a calm, green ribbon of historic architecture, art museums, and riverside promenades that feels worlds away from the noise of Minami. Here the stately red-brick Osaka City Central Public Hall anchors a cluster of galleries, a famous rose garden, leafy walkways, and stylish waterside cafes. It’s where Osaka comes to slow down, stroll, and look at art and the water.
